tools.name: list_my_events
tools.title: List my events
tools.summary: The events you host and the landing pages you can edit, with their links.

example.ask: Which events am I hosting?

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Read an event page
tools.summary: Everything on a page that can change: each section's words, its photos, the sections you added and the run of show.

example.ask: Read me what's on the Sunday Supper page.

tools.name: update_page
tools.title: Change page words
tools.summary: Change the words of a page's sections. Only the fields you name change.

example.ask: Make the headline warmer.

tools.name: add_section
tools.title: Add a page section
tools.summary: Add a section of your own: a photo with a heading, a headline, a paragraph and a hosted-by line. Up to six.

example.ask: Add a section about the music after the gathering section.

arguments.title: Three guitars and a cello
arguments.body: Live, unplugged, and close enough to feel.

tools.name: update_section
tools.title: Change an added section
tools.summary: Change a section you added: its words, its place on the page or its photo.

example.ask: Shorten the music paragraph.

tools.name: remove_section
tools.title: Remove an added section
tools.summary: Remove a section you added. Anything after it moves up.

example.ask: Take the music section off.

tools.name: set_photo
tools.title: Set a section photo
tools.summary: Give a section a new photo from a direct link, or go back to the one it had.

example.ask: Use this photo for the opening.

tools.name: update_style
tools.title: Change the page look
tools.summary: Change how the page looks: colours, fonts, the order of sections, button labels and the layout.

example.ask: Switch to the ocean palette and fit it on one screen.

tools.name: set_share
tools.title: Make the share preview
tools.summary: Make the share card people see when the event's grateful.gg link is sent. It can be drawn as a preview before it is saved.

example.ask: Show me a share card before you save it.

tools.name: update_event
tools.title: Change event details
tools.summary: Change the event itself: its name, place line, who needs approval, the guest limit, the waitlist and the run of show.

example.ask: Cap it at 40 guests and let me approve every request.

tools.name: make_photo
tools.title: Make a photo
tools.summary: Make a new photo for any photo on the page from a few words, on the hosts' monthly AI budget. You see both versions before one is used.

example.ask: Make the opening photo a candlelit rooftop at dusk.

arguments.prompt: A candlelit rooftop at dusk, seen from behind the guests

tools.name: create_event
tools.title: Create a draft event
tools.summary: Start a new event page as a draft, with RSVPs closed until you publish it.

example.ask: Start a potluck in Venice on Sunday the 22nd at noon.

gathering.title: Bring a dish, meet a neighbour
gathering.body: Long tables, good food, new friends.

tools.name: make_art
tools.title: Make 4 opening images
tools.summary: Make four versions of the opening image from a description.

example.ask: Picture a long table under string lights at dusk.

arguments.description: A long table under string lights at dusk, warm and painted

tools.name: change_art
tools.title: Change one opening image
tools.summary: Take your note on one image and make four new takes of it.

example.ask: On the second one, make the sky more pink.

tools.name: show_art
tools.title: Show the opening images
tools.summary: Show the newest four images again, and which one is on the page.

example.ask: Show me the four images again.

tools.name: choose_art
tools.title: Use an opening image
tools.summary: Put the image you picked on the page as its opening, sized for phones and computers.

example.ask: Use the third one.

tools.name: publish_event
tools.title: Publish an event
tools.summary: Put a new event live: RSVPs open and its grateful.gg share link is made. Only after you have seen the draft and said yes.

example.ask: It looks right. Publish it.

tools.name: upload_event_page
tools.title: Upload a landing page
tools.summary: Replace the event's page with one of your own design. It is saved as a draft with a preview link.

example.ask: Use the page I just designed.

tools.name: get_event_page
tools.title: Read the uploaded page
tools.summary: Read the page you uploaded, to revise it: the waiting draft if there is one, else the live page.

example.ask: What is in my uploaded page right now?

tools.name: add_page_asset
tools.title: Keep a picture or video for a page
tools.summary: Keep a picture or video from a link that would expire, so your page can use it for good.

example.ask: Keep this image so the link never breaks.

tools.name: publish_event_page
tools.title: Publish the uploaded page
tools.summary: Put your uploaded page live, after you have looked at the preview and said yes.

example.ask: Put my page live.

tools.name: remove_event_page
tools.title: Go back to the Oasis page
tools.summary: Take your uploaded page down and show the event's Oasis page again. Your uploads are kept.

example.ask: Go back to the Oasis page.

tools.name: move_event
tools.title: Move an event's date
tools.summary: Move a live event to a new date and tell everyone going by email, with an updated calendar invite. It previews first and moves only with your yes.

example.ask: Move it to the 29th, same time. Show me the note first.

tools.name: list_payouts
tools.title: See what the hosts are owed
tools.summary: What the hosts are owed for each event: what was collected, the fees, what has been paid and what is still to come.

example.ask: What am I owed for Sunday Supper?

tools.name: list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.summary: Who is coming, as the host panel shows it: name, status and party size.

example.ask: Who is on the waitlist?

tools.name: add_guests
tools.title: Add guests
tools.summary: Add people straight to Going, up to 100 at a time. Each one gets the confirmation email unless you say not to.

example.ask: Add Sam and Priya, no emails yet.

tools.name: check_in
tools.title: Check a guest in
tools.summary: Check a guest in at the door, the whole party or some of it.

example.ask: Sam's party of two just arrived.

arguments.guest_id: the id list_guests gave for Sam

tools.name: remove_guest
tools.title: Remove a guest
tools.summary: Take a guest off the list quietly. No email goes to them and their seat is freed.

example.ask: Take Priya off the list.

arguments.guest_id: the id list_guests gave for Priya

tools.name: restore_guest
tools.title: Restore a removed guest
tools.summary: Put back a guest a host removed.

example.ask: Put Priya back.

arguments.guest_id: the id list_guests gave for Priya

tools.name: message_guests
tools.title: Email guests
tools.summary: Email the guests, signed by the hosts. It previews first and sends only after you say yes.

example.ask: Draft a note to everyone going about parking.

arguments.subject: Parking on Sunday
arguments.message: Street parking is easiest on Rose Avenue. See you at noon.

tools.name: decide_guest
tools.title: Approve or decline a guest
tools.summary: Approve or decline someone who asked to come, or someone on the waitlist. It previews first and decides only with your yes.

example.ask: Let Priya in from the waitlist.

arguments.guest_id: the id list_guests gave for Priya

tools.name: get_design_system
tools.title: Read the Oasis design brief
tools.summary: Read the Oasis design brief before proposing a change to the Oasis itself.

example.ask: What are the Oasis design rules?

tools.name: submit_design_idea
tools.title: Submit a design idea
tools.summary: Send the Grateful Giraffes team a design idea, with a mockup if you have one.

example.ask: Send the team my idea for the RSVP button.

arguments.title: Keep RSVP in reach on phones
arguments.problem: On a small phone the RSVP button sits below the first screen.
arguments.proposal: Pin it to the bottom of the screen.

tools.name: list_my_design_ideas
tools.title: List my design ideas
tools.summary: See the ideas you sent and what the team answered.

example.ask: Did the team answer my idea?
